timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,852.27 Cr (+12.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹74.24 Cr (+11.9% YoY).

ANS Holding Private Limited, A to Z Securities Limited, Focal Leasing & Credits Limited, JBM Builders Private Limited, JBM International Limited, and JBM Industries Private Limited declared holding 2,08,29,980; 2,76,15,800; 78,95,658; 1,51,54,160; 1,07,49,994; and 3,600 equity shares of JBM Auto Limited respectively as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
JBM Auto reported leading India's electric bus market with a 49% share and 157 vehicle registrations in May 2026.
